name: Unkind Words
overview: Scripture teaches that controlling our speech is vital for a godly life, as unkind or deceitful words can wound deeply and lead to destruction, while wise and gentle words bring healing and peace. The Psalms emphasize guarding our tongues by asking the Lord to watch over our speech, highlighting the spiritual discipline required to avoid evil words. Proverbs contrasts the harm caused by harsh words with the life-giving power of a wholesome tongue, showing that careful speech can prevent anger and promote reconciliation. Ultimately, the Bible calls believers to speak with wisdom and kindness, reflecting the heart transformed by Christ.
